_readme: [pipeline 7]P-5's gate artifact. The pack declares which licence families it consumes; this record
says those families were checked against tooling/legal/content-licence-register.json and every one
was CLEARED. assert-content-licences.mjs re-derives the same verdict from the register and the
recipe on every push, so this file cannot drift into a claim nobody re-checks.
content_hash BINDS IT TO ONE PACK. An artifact naming a different pack is the same defect as a
missing one, and it is the one that happens after a re-run leaves five stale reports behind.

families.cleared_by: in-tree, first-party — no third-party term to interpret
